text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder and I are headed back<n>to the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for today. That<n>was just the
break I needed.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, what's this? Look over there...

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text: Dear me... How will I ever cross?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
An elderly woman with a big suitcase<n>is standing
next to a crosswalk.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course. Excuse me, ma'am.

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
Thank you ever so much for your<n>help, my dear. I
hope it wasn't too<n>much trouble.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: No, no, think nothing of it.

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
My, how polite you are... I'm glad to<n>see there are
still Umamusume like<n>you upholding the Yamato
Nadeshiko<n>ideals.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Thank you for the compliment.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder bows until the lady is<n>out of sight.
choice_data_list: She's right—you're such an upstanding soul.
She's right—you're such an upstanding soul.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you both flatter me too much... But<n>thank you,
either way.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You know, when I first arrived here in<n>Japan, I felt
like such a fish out of<n>water.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It was really difficult to work out<n>nuances and
keep up with the way<n>people speak.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And I often tripped over my words,<n>making it
difficult for others to<n>understand me.
choice_data_list: Really? How did you sound back then?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hmm, well... all right. It's a bit<n>embarrassing, but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Good speaking, very hard. Long ago, I<n>practice
many, then I come to school.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. How's that for an example? I<n>won't be
doing that again.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Either way, I don't think I've come<n>far enough to
be called a true Yamato<n>Nadeshiko just yet.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
This conversation has shown me a<n>side of Grass
Wonder that I never<n>knew about.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Not so much. My mother was well<n>versed in
Japanese culture, and I<n>often had Japanese food
while in the<n>United States.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Although... There was one food that<n>gave me quite
the surprise.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Authentic wasabi.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I had heard it was nothing like what<n>we had at
home, but nothing could<n>have prepared me for that
tingling fire<n>in my nose.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I've come to enjoy it now, but<n>it wasn't
easy.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Either way, I don't think I've come<n>far enough to
be called a true Yamato<n>Nadeshiko just yet.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
This conversation has shown me a<n>side of Grass
Wonder that I never<n>knew about.
